news.title: Sentuo Group boss hands Black Challenge $10,000 each after 2026 Amputee World Cup win
news.lede: The Executive Chairman of Sentuo Group, Ningquan Xu, has rewarded each member of the Black Challenge with US$10,000 following Ghana’s historic triumph at the Amputee Football World Cup. The cash reward comes in recognition of the team’s remarkable achievement in Mexico, where Ghana defeated Morocco 1-0 in the final to become the second African nation to win the prestigious tournament after Angola. The gesture adds to the growing list of financial rewards and commendations received by the players following their historic campaign. The donation was made to the team during a dinner organised for them on Friday, November 27, a day after their arrival from their memorable campaign in Norther America.

news.title: Brazil, Ireland advance to round of 32 at FIFA U-17 World Cup
news.lede: 28 (SANA) Brazil and Ireland secured their places in the knockout stage of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in Qatar with victories in their final group-stage matches. Brazil cruised to a 3-0 victory over Costa Rica, finishing top of the group with a perfect record of three wins from three matches and nine points. In the group’s other match, Ireland defeated Tanzania 3-1 to finish second with six points and advance to the round of 32. Tanzania and Costa Rica exited the tournament after finishing third and fourth, respectively, with one point each.

news.title: World Cup 2026: US Women Face El Salvador in Qualifier
news.lede: The United States women face El Salvador for the first time in a Concacaf W Championship quarterfinal, with a berth at the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil at stake. The tournament also offers places at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Readers asking who won the World Cup 2026 should know that the United States women's team is competing for a place at the 2027 Women's World Cup. The Americans face El Salvador in a 2026 Concacaf W Championship quarterfinal, with the winner qualifying for the tournament in Brazil.

news.title: "It Was Terrible!" - Megan Connolly Grateful One Thing Has Changed Since Ireland's Last World Cup Playoff
news.lede: "Megan Connolly admitted this week that she is grateful to be involved in Ireland's World Cup playoff against Poland next week, having missed out on the win in Glasgow which booked the Girls in Green's place at the 2023 tournament. Connolly watched the dramatic 1-0 win over Scotland from home in Cork with her family four years ago. Speaking to the Irish media at a press event on Friday, she said that having to watch the most important game of her career at home with her parents and brother was a challenging experience, to say the least. "I could have went out there to watch it but I chose to stay at home with Mum and Dad and my brother was there as well," Connolly said of that famous night in Glasgow in 2022.

news.title: Sanchez hat-trick sends USWNT to the World Cup with 8-0 qualifying victory over El Salvador
news.lede: Mansfield Ashley Sanchez scored three goals in the first half, and the United States secured a spot in the 2027 Women’s World Cup with an 8-0 victory over El Salvador in the quarterfinals of the CONCACAF W Championship on Friday night. The United States advances to the semifinals to play Jamaica, which clinched a World Cup berth earlier in the day with a 3-0 quarterfinal victory over Costa Rica at Texas Health Mansfield Stadium. The quarterfinals continue on Saturday with Canada facing Panama and Mexico meeting Haiti. All four quarterfinal winners earn direct berths in the World Cup in Brazil.

news.title: Vietnam’s U17 World Cup journey ends, but the real challenge lies ahead
news.lede: Reflecting on Vietnam's historic World Cup campaign, Roland said this generation of U17 players deserved greater attention and investment. Addressing their physical limitations, he stressed that the issue was not unique to this particular age group. His assessment deserves serious consideration. Coaches can improve tactics and strengthen team spirit, but overcoming physical and technical shortcomings accumulated over years of training is considerably more difficult.
